{{Top|leg}}
'''Contraband Incorporated''', abbreviated '''Contraband Inc.''', was a carrier of contraband during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Their pilots flew [[M3-A Scyk interceptor/Legends|M3-A Scyk fighters]] and [[M12-L Kimogila heavy fighter]]s.<ref name="SWG:ES">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=other|Endor system}}</ref>

==History==
During [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Contraband Incorporated carried contraband through the [[Empire's Justice]] quadrant in the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]].<ref name="SWG:ES" />

==Behind the scenes==
Contraband Incorporated appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:ES" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Contraband Incorporated was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWG:ES" />
